summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by the issuing entity of a CMBS transaction (BMO 2026-5C16 Mortgage Trust), reporting the entry into a pooling and servicing agreement for the issuance of commercial mortgage pass-through certificates. No corporate action affecting equity holders, takeover, or restructuring event. This is an ABS securitization with sponsor loans, servicing agreements, and issuance mechanics. This is a standard securitization current report and does not represent a special-situation event.
